name: Pushouse
description: WhatsApp automation + e-commerce tools — broadcasts, carts, engagement for merchants who live in WhatsApp (UAE-founded, MENA/global e-com vibe).

mentions.evidence: ~$25.9k MRR, 248 active subscriptions, ~$34.2k L30, ~$278k all-time, ~1,500 users claimed, founded Jan 2026, UAE. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Country/channel messaging ops for e-com (WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage) beats another generic email ESP — especially where WhatsApp is default.

whyItPrints: In many markets WhatsApp is the CRM. Pushouse sells channel ops, not a new social network — high L30 vs young founding date suggests merchants already paying for delivery infra.
whyThisMatters:
Merchants who already talk to customers on WhatsApp use Pushouse for the messages around an order. New members get a welcome. Someone who hasn't bought yet gets a nudge. Birthdays, bulk sends, and the anniversary of a first purchase are included. Quiet customers get a win-back. Abandoned carts get a reminder. So do back-in-stock alerts, order updates, shipping links, and a nudge to reorder. Incoming chats can be routed. After delivery, a survey asks for a review.

The shop site gets modules too. A spin-to-win, a discount tab, announcements, shoppable photo tags, and product suggestions. There's a helper that looks for the right item, cookie consent, an exit survey, and your Instagram feed. Trendyol reviews can show on the store. Each module has a 14-day trial, and a card is required.

They set it up for fashion, beauty, grocery, restaurants, hotels, and similar shops. The company was founded in the UAE in January 2026. The customer is already on WhatsApp. Pushouse sends the messages and runs the extras on the site.
